changes: Pin every delegated run to an exact execution contract with ownership, behavior, checks and an authorized endpoint.
Support exact-instruction and outcome-delegation modes under the same authorization and evidence constraints.
Use completion events and disjoint ownership for parallel work without adding a coordinator or repeated unchanged status polling.
Gate test-file changes through the reviewed test-change policy and require an actual evidence gap report.
Resolve QA fixtures once, keep browser execution neutral, and package deterministic media with originals and a 4-6 frame contact sheet.
Keep benchmark profiles and simulated-ticket protocol private to the parent rather than global specialist defaults.
